seo_title: Delhi HC Settles Devans-Cartel Bros Godfather Case
title: Delhi HC Records Settlement Recognising Devans' Rights in 'Godfather' Mark
case_name: Devans Modern Breweries Limited v. Cartel Bros Private Limited & Anr.
citation: CS(COMM) 346/2026, Delhi High Court, decree on settlement terms dated 6 November 2026 (Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav, J.); earlier interim injunction reported as 2026 DHC 5156 (Tushar Rao Gedela, J., June 2026)
card_summary: The Delhi High Court recorded a settlement between Devans Modern Breweries Limited, maker of Godfather beer, and Cartel Bros Private Limited, backed by actor Sanjay Dutt, over the Godfather mark on whisky. Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav decreed the suit on terms recognising Devans' rights in the mark, with a permanent injunction against Cartel Bros and withdrawal of its rectification petitions.
card_tip: Where a court has already held two product categories allied and cognate for trademark purposes, such as beer and whisky here, the later user has little room left to litigate and often settles on the senior user's terms.
verification_notes: AUDIENCE: domestic (two Indian beverage companies and their promoters). TARGET QUERY: can the same trademark be used for beer and whisky in India. DEMAND EVIDENCE: none seen. Cross-verified across LiveLaw Biz, Bar and Bench and Open Magazine, which agree on the parties (Devans Modern Breweries Limited and Cartel Bros Private Limited & Anr.), the case number (CS(COMM) 346/2026), the 6 November 2026 settlement decree by Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav, and the terms recognising Devans' rights in GODFATHER with a permanent injunction against Cartel Bros and withdrawal of Cartel Bros's rectification petitions. The earlier June 2026 interim injunction holding beer and whisky to be allied and cognate goods is reported via Bar and Bench and, by case number 2026 DHC 5156, via Verdictum; that bench and date are stated on those two sources. No figures beyond the case numbers and dates shown in these reports are stated.
